scope: Additional AI quality engineering candidates covering LLM evaluation, RAG retrieval and generation boundaries, prompt injection, model and tool contracts, agent orchestration, dataset governance, observability, cost and latency correctness, and AI safety QA.

collisionMethod.slug: Reject exact, containing, or contained slugs against the 1,778-item baseline, current selected and reserves, final campaign selection, every mining file, intent-audit rejects and replacements, and this survivor set.
collisionMethod.title: Reject more than 60 percent normalized non-stopword token overlap against inventory titles, campaign titles, mining titles, audit records, and this survivor set.
collisionMethod.primaryKeyword: Reject exact normalized primary keywords across every baseline, selected, reserve, mining, audit, and new survivor record.
collisionMethod.intent: Apply the independent publication audit before acceptance and state a precise boundary that excludes adjacent owners and broad guides.
collisionMethod.evidence: Require two to five existing repository paths, three to five canonical internal routes, and two to four authoritative primary sources.
collisionMethod.safety: Reject offensive disclosure, bypass recipes, unsupported vendor behavior, invented benchmarks, and topics without honest 3,000-word depth.
